Westfield (the third full-range cluster) heads it "Minimum shear strength (double shear)" with NO unit anywhere on the page (no kN in header, legend or notes); reading it as kN is inference from magnitude. Without Westfield only globalfastener + fasten.it (+ SPIROL for 2-12 mm) state kN double shear -> 2 clusters on 16 of 25 rows. Keeping the column would leave only 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 8, 10, 12 (8 rows x 4 = 32 cells) vs 25 x 3 = 75 cells without it, so the column goes. If the lead accepts the unit-less header, the shear values of the 25 kept rows all have >=3 clusters (GF, WF, FI) with no rival except 13 (115.12 on 4 schrauben-lexikon-lineage pages -> row 13 would then go)

shape_hint: A hollow cylindrical pin rolled from spring-steel strip with one straight axial slot along its whole length (C-shaped cross-section, wall thickness s, inner diameter d2), chamfered at both ends; made slightly larger than the hole and compressed when driven in.

role_map.s: wall thickness (s; globalfastener letters it h in the same drawing)

notes: Heavy duty slotted spring pins only. Candidate table had 28 sizes x 5 columns; kept 27 x 4. Exactly three clusters carry the ISO numbers over the whole size range: globalfastener (ISO 8752-2009 and DIN EN ISO 8752-2009 pages; fullerfasteners is the same template and is not counted separately), Westfield Fasteners (own product specification page, with its own typo 22.5 at size 18) and fasten.it (DIN EN ISO 8752 sheet). fasteners.eu / boltsfastener / digipich (one group, sizes 1-13) and schrauben-lexikon (+ boltport and ferrofast, which repeat its typos 16.9 at 18 and 115.12 at 13) print the DIN 1481 numbers under the ISO 8752 title: they agree everywhere except d2 and s at nominal 6 (3.9 / 1.25). Also confirmed by >= 3 clusters for all 28 sizes but not in the candidate table: d1 before mounting max and min (e.g. 1.3 / 1.2 at size 1 ... 50.9 / 50.5 at size 50) and a min; values are in spring-sl.evidence.json. Edition note (globalfastener only, not counted): ISO 8752-1987 and EN 28752-1993 give a max 2.4 / min 2 at nominal 8, the 1997 and 2009 editions 2 / 1.6. The shear column applies to steel and martensitic stainless pins only (stated by globalfastener, Westfield and fasten.it); austenitic pins have no value. Pin length series is not part of this table. Sizes 7 and 9 on schrauben-lexikon/boltport are not ISO 8752 sizes on the other pages.

verification.checks_done: Independent re-fetch on 2026-11-11 with curl (browser UA, 2.5 s pause per site) of every counted and rival page; SKF pages rendered with playwright; drawings downloaded and read to confirm letter mappings. Own parser (html.parser with rowspan/colspan expansion) and own per-site extraction in scratchpad t2/g4v/code (v_spring.py, v_sens.py); researcher raw/ and scripts not used. Counted only maker/distributor HTML tables whose header or drawing states the column meaning; 25 rows x 3 cols kept, every kept cell has >= 3 independent clusters with exactly the same number. Sanity checks recomputed on kept rows.
